Citymaker.Recipe.Farmstead.Description: A working farm: farmyard with barns and silos, fields by crop with rows, hedgerows, tracks, paddocks and a pond.
Citymaker.Farmstead.Name: Farmstead
Citymaker.Farmstead.subtype.Tooltip: What the farm mostly does. Presets set everything below to match; you can still change each option.
Citymaker.Farmstead.yardAt.Tooltip: Where the farmyard with the barns and silos sits: by the road entrance, in the middle, or in a corner.
Citymaker.Farmstead.yardSize.Tooltip: Share of the area the farmyard covers (it never gets smaller than about 22 m).
Citymaker.Farmstead.tracks.Tooltip: Spine: one track along the farm through the yard. Grid: plus cross tracks every second field. None: only the driveway.
Citymaker.Farmstead.fieldSize.Tooltip: Typical size of one field in hectares. Fields follow a grid aligned with the farm's long axis.
Citymaker.Farmstead.arablePct.Tooltip: Share of the fields under crops (ploughed, in rows); the rest is pasture and hay meadow.
Citymaker.Farmstead.rowAngle.Tooltip: Direction of the crop rows: along each field's long side, along or across the farm, or alternating field by field (patchwork).
Citymaker.Farmstead.rowSpacing.Tooltip: Distance between the painted crop rows (vegetable plots use half of it).
Citymaker.Farmstead.cropProps.Tooltip: Crop plants on arable fields: none (paint only), the outer rows of each field, or every row (many objects).
Citymaker.Farmstead.hayMeadows.Tooltip: Some grass fields are mown hay meadows with bales lying in the swaths.
Citymaker.Farmstead.fieldPaint.Tooltip: Paints ploughed soil and crop rows into the terrain texture. Permanent: removing the farm does not unpaint.
Citymaker.Farmstead.paintLayer.Tooltip: Terrain layer (1–4) used for ploughed soil, the yard and worn ground. Which texture each is depends on the map.
Citymaker.Farmstead.stripeLayer.Tooltip: Terrain layer (1–4) painted in stripes for the crop rows and mown swaths.
Citymaker.Farmstead.windpump.Tooltip: A wind pump in a corner of the farmyard (when one is installed).
Citymaker.Farmstead.levelYard.Tooltip: Flattens the farmyard, blended into the ground around it. Permanent terrain change.
Citymaker.Farmstead.paddocks.Tooltip: Fenced livestock paddocks around the farmyard, each with a gate towards the yard, a trough and a field shelter.
Citymaker.Farmstead.animals.Tooltip: Animal spawners in the paddocks and pastures. Horses and ranches also get a round pen.
Citymaker.Farmstead.fieldHedges.Tooltip: Hedgerows between the fields, with a gateway in the middle of every field side.
Citymaker.Farmstead.hedgeTrees.Tooltip: Trees standing in the hedgerows, per 100 m of hedge.
Citymaker.Farmstead.pondSize.Tooltip: Diameter of the farm pond. The basin and its water are permanent.
Citymaker.Farmstead.pondAt.Tooltip: Where the pond goes: the lowest ground (where water collects), next to the farmyard, or far from it.
Citymaker.Farmstead.Issue.NoYard: Farmstead: no room for a farmyard; the farm is fields only.
Citymaker.Farmstead.Issue.NoFields: Farmstead: no room left for fields. Make the area bigger or the fields smaller.
Citymaker.Farmstead.Issue.NoPond: Farmstead: no room for the pond.
Citymaker.AddOn.Apiary.Name: Beehives
Citymaker.AddOn.Apiary.layout.Tooltip: Hives in neat rows, a loose cluster, or a ring.
Citymaker.AddOn.Apiary.where.Tooltip: A quiet spot by the edge, the most open spot, or near the centre.
Citymaker.AddOn.Apiary.flowers.Tooltip: A ring of flowerbeds around the hives.
Citymaker.AddOn.FarmStand.Name: Farm stand
Citymaker.AddOn.FarmStand.where.Tooltip: By the entrances, along the paths, or along the edges.
Citymaker.AddOn.FarmStand.crates.Tooltip: Crates of produce stacked on both sides of the stall.
